 Kristof Gleich – Boutique Managers and Active ETFs at Harbor Capital (EP.411) 
 
 Kristof Gleich – Boutique Managers and Active ETFs at Harbor Capital (EP.411) Oct 10, 2024

 Kristof Gleich is the President and CIO of
Harbor Capital Advisors. Harbor is a forty-year old firm that
manages $62 billion by partnering with boutique active managers to
roll out active ETFs, collective investment trusts, and
historically, mutual funds.

Kristof joined Harbor in 2018 and watched as the actively managed
mutual fund company had $22 billion of outflows, or a third of its
assets, in his first year on the job. He led a turnaround of the
business to transition from a traditional mutual fund company to an
innovative leader in the active ETF space.

Our conversation covers the lessons Kristof learned about culture
from his time at Goldman Sachs and JP Morgan, and his application
of those lessons to turnaround Harbor. We discuss the challenges of
making it happen, the rise of active ETFs, Harbor’s approach to
standing out in a crowded field, its manager selection process,
distribution, and the future of alternative investments in the ETF
space.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
